$comment: Answers 'may we use this'. Every restored package must carry an allow-listed SPDX expression, or an exception the owner has decided on. Pending exceptions fail the gate on purpose (standing rule: stop and ask). Permissive still means attribution: see tools/notices-input and the notices gate. npm packages (web/package-lock.json, development tooling included) are under the same policy; their notices cover the production closure only.

exceptions.licence: Microsoft Software License Terms for the MICROSOFT.DATA.SQLCLIENT.SNI library (LICENSE.txt inside the package; proprietary, distributable as part of applications, carries an indemnification clause and a no-Excluded-License clause)
exceptions.why: Transitive dependency of Microsoft.Data.SqlClient; Windows-only native network layer. It is not used on Linux hosts but is present in a portable (RID-less) publish.
exceptions.approvedBy: owner (chat message, product to be released as open source; the component is fetched from the package feed at build time and is never stored in the repository)
